scope: T15 cohort inventory and overlap audit only; identified candidate resources, not an exhaustive census of all historic GWAS.
overlap_unit: cohort sampling frame; exact shared participant counts are unknown unless separately supplied

datasets.label: FinnGen R13 strict AIHT
datasets.notes: Local endpoint counts, not external replication.

datasets.label: FinnGen R13 strict Graves
datasets.notes: Same FinnGen participant pool; cross-trait case/control overlap not quantified.

datasets.label: ThyroidOmics 2026 EUR
datasets.phenotype: AIHT/Hashimoto: E06.3 or E03.9 with exclusions
datasets.notes: No FinnGen cohort; includes UKB. Fails stricter FinnGen-plus-UKB exclusion gate.

datasets.label: ThyroidOmics 2026 overall
datasets.phenotype: AIHT/Hashimoto: E06.3 or E03.9 with exclusions
datasets.notes: Includes UKB and BBJ; nested EUR/overall strata are not independent studies.

datasets.label: BBJ bbj-a-123
datasets.notes: Prefer task-prespecified BBJ resource; ancestry-matched LD required in T17.

datasets.label: BBJ GCST90018627
datasets.notes: Same BBJ sampling frame as bbj-a-123; do not count as independent second replication. File build pending.

datasets.label: Reeve 2026 FinnGen-UKB AIHT
datasets.phenotype: Strict AIHT matched across FinnGen and UKB
datasets.notes: FinnGen R12 overlaps R13; no independent replication.

datasets.label: Reeve 2026 Graves-labelled meta
datasets.phenotype: E4_THYTOXGOITDIF comparator; phenotype differs from strict Graves
datasets.notes: ST3 table index identifies endpoint; exact downloaded file definition/build pending.

datasets.label: Sakaue EUR GCST90018855
datasets.notes: European arm UKB plus FinnGen R3; catalog record also includes Japanese arm.

datasets.label: Sakaue EUR GCST90018847
datasets.notes: Not UKB-only; Finland and UK recruitment documented in Catalog.

datasets.label: 2025 hypothyroidism full discovery
datasets.notes: Do not substitute PRS training cohort composition for discovery meta.

datasets.label: 2025 GCST90572791 public subset
datasets.notes: Still contains FinnGen and UKB. Catalog partitions 98805/948186 and 14588/117082; release-specific N not promoted without file metadata.

datasets.label: Saevarsdottir 2020 AITD
datasets.notes: No FinnGen in stated cohorts; fails stricter UKB exclusion. Mixed endpoint cannot replace AIHT or Graves.

datasets.label: Reeve UKB-only AIHT component
datasets.notes: Separate summary-file access and control N unresolved; UKB excluded by frozen strict independence gate.

datasets.label: UKB-only Graves candidate
datasets.phenotype: Exact Graves endpoint must be verified
datasets.notes: Proposed resource, not an observed downloaded dataset; cannot use GCST90018847 as substitute.

datasets.label: MVP AIHT-compatible candidate
datasets.notes: Public MVP hypothyroidism example does not establish AIHT equivalence, exact EUR release or sample composition.

datasets.label: China Consortium 2011 GWAS
datasets.notes: 3994/3510 follow-up tested selected SNPs; not added to discovery N. Build/full-summary access unresolved.
